description:
intent=i016 snapshot=s05 branch=nonlinear-linear-assume status=complete
finding location=net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_rt.c:103-113 confidence=high conclusion=rt_mt6() dereferences the unchecked skb_header_pointer() result rp at net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_rt.c:112 on the IP6T_RT_RES path, so a non-linear IPv6 routing-header packet gives a NULL-read/crash in the receive-side xt match.
finding location=net/netfilter/nfnetlink_osf.c:185-190 confidence=medium conclusion=nf_osf_hdr_ctx_init() ignores the NULL return of skb_header_pointer() into ctx->optp (nfnetlink_osf.c:188), and nf_osf_match_one() dereferences *ctx->optp (line 99), so a non-linear TCP SYN packet with doff>5 and a matching OSF fingerprint NULL-derefs on receive.
unresolved location=net/6lowpan/nhc.c:64 conclusion=Follow up: trace ieee802154 RX into lowpan_nhc_by_nhcid() to determine whether a non-linear skb (frag list) can reach nhc.c:75 memcpy and read beyond skb_headlen().
unresolved location=net/nfc/digital_dep.c:497 conclusion=Follow up: audit nfc_alloc_recv_skb and the digital-target response path to confirm every parsed skb is fully linear before dereferencing skb->data casts in digital_dep.c.
coverage_gap=Legacy subsystems flagged by the coarse skb->data cast scan (net/802/fddi.c:95, net/appletalk/aarp.c:555, net/atm/br2684.c:396, net/ife/ife.c:50-75) were only skimmed; none showed an attacker-length-driven variable header, but per-function reachability traces were not done.
coverage_gap=NFC (net/nfc/digital_*.c, llcp_core.c) skb->data struct casts were enumerated but only structurally triaged; the allocation/linearization behavior of the NFC digital receive path was not audited.
coverage_gap=Only skb_header_pointer NULL-check misses and skb->data casts were scanned; direct skb_transport_header()/skb_network_header() dereferences without a preceding pskb_may_pull in *_rcv handlers were not systematically enumerated.
limitation=Both findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no KASAN build or crafted packet was run; the ip6t_rt NULL dereference additionally requires the IP6T_RT_RES match flag and a non-linear routing-header packet, and the osf one requires a loaded fingerprint whose foptsize equals the attacker-chosen optsize.
limitation=skb_header_pointer() returns NULL for bytes outside the linear head, so the concrete failure mode of both findings is a NULL-pointer read (or a parse of bytes that are not there) rather than the seed's use-after-free; the branch treats both as the same missing-linear-guarantee invariant.
limitation=The NULL-check scanner used a 4-line window and simple statement joining, so a small number of false negatives among the remaining ~270 skb_header_pointer call sites cannot be excluded.
